head: frʕ 2 (see Tezel 71; cf. probably Syr. prʕ 1 ‘to uncover; to dishevel’; Arb. Syr. frʕ ‘couper les branches, élaguer, tailler’ Barthelemy 602)

notes: frd/frḏ (cf. Kurd. firdikîn être émietté KFD 506; RW 64 fərḏino/ fərḏuno m, pl –e Krume; Ilyas says farduno)

senses.gloss: (trans.) to crumble, to change (money), to take out (like grains out of ears)  [KFARZE!]

stems.sensesRaw: (trans.) to crumble, to change (money), to take out (like grains out of ears)  [KFARZE!]

examples.turoyo: gǝmfaradno u laḥmo bayn a tlawḥe.
examples.translation: I will crumble the bread in the lentil (soup).
examples.raw: gǝmfaradno u laḥmo bayn a tlawḥe. I will crumble the bread in the lentil (soup). (Ilyas p.c)

examples.translation: I will change all my money.
examples.raw: gǝmfaradno ak kallawatayḏi kulle. I will change all my money. (Ilyas p.c)

examples.translation: I will crumble the sugar in the tea.
examples.raw: gǝmfaradno u šakar bi čaye. I will crumble the sugar in the tea.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: mfaradli mo waroqe b ʕaṣro ʕaṣrowat.
examples.translation: I changed hundred liras for ten tens.
examples.raw: mfaradli mo waroqe b ʕaṣro ʕaṣrowat. I changed hundred liras for ten tens. (Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: ko maḥti maye aʕlayye w ko maḥtənne bayn am maye,  ko mifardi (Ilyas p.c.)
examples.translation: They put/pour water on them and they put them in water, they crumble.
examples.raw: ko maḥti maye aʕlayye w ko maḥtənne bayn am maye,  ko mifardi (Ilyas p.c.)  They put/pour water on them and they put them in water, they crumble.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: u laḥmo ko mifarad  bayn a tlawḥe (Ilyas p.c).
examples.translation: The bread is crumbled in the lentil (soup).
examples.raw: u laḥmo ko mifarad  bayn a tlawḥe (Ilyas p.c). The bread is crumbled in the lentil (soup). (Ilyas p.c)

examples.translation: The wheats were taken out of ears.
examples.raw: mfardi aḥ ḥeṭe maš šǝble. The wheats were taken out of ears.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.translation: The stones were taken out of the wall.
examples.raw: mfardi ak kefe du šuro.  The stones were taken out of the wall.(Ilyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: mfardi aʕ ʕǝnwe maṣ suġle [meqǝm ruḥayye].
examples.translation: Grapes were taken out from bunch.
examples.raw: mfardi aʕ ʕǝnwe maṣ suġle [meqǝm ruḥayye]. Grapes were taken out from bunch. (Ilyas p.c)
